twi: Yei kyerɛ sɛ, ɛberɛ a amannɔne sika a yɛnya firi amansan boseabɔ edwa so ne sika a ɛfiri adwadeɛ a yɛde kɔ amannɔne mu no so reteɛ, na afei ɛsiane sɛdeɛ yɛpɛ amannɔne nneɛma pa ara enti, sika a yɛde kra nneɛma firi amannɔne no nso kɔ ara na ɛrekɔ soro, na amannɔne ɛka a yɛde no nso kɔ ara na ɛrekɔ soro no, na yɛn sika mu duru no so te ara na ɛreteɛ.
english: ‘’We are currently in a crisis driven by rising fuel prices caused by the rapid loss in value of the local currency, as well as high international crude oil prices.

twi: Afe 2023 mu no, Aban bɛgye mmoa afiri EXIM sikakorabea (EXIM bank) no hɔ nam so asisi mfidie a wɔde yɛ ɔyɛasaseyie a wɔmfaa mu no bi afoforɔ, asane atrɛtrɛ deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ dada no mu.
english: The details of the 2023 expenditure is summarised in the Figure 5.

twi: Ogyahoɔden 40. Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na yɛbɛsi ogyahoɔden a yɛhwere wɔ ɛberɛ a yɛde anyinam ahoɔden rekɔ mmeammea a ɛhia wɔ ne kyɛ mu ano na ɛho nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa bɛkɔ nkan enti no, yɛwiee, Firaw Mantam- Achimota anyinam ahoma ho dwumadie (161kV Volta-Achimota- Mallam Transmission Line Upgrade) no.
english: Energy 40. In order to reduce transmission and distribution system losses and improve transmission system reliability, the 161kV Volta- Achimota-Mallam Transmission Line Upgrade Project was completed and is in operation.

twi: Aban botaeɛ a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛma anyinam akɔ nkuro a nsuo atwa ho ahyia (supɔ) na ɛhɔ kɔ yɛ den no enti, yɛafiri aseɛ asisi ɛho mfidie mmiɛnsa wɔ Azizkpe, Aflive ne Alorkpem a ɛwɔ Ada Apueeɛ Mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran Mantam mu no mu.
english: As part of Government’s strategy to electrify island communities and hard-to-reach areas with renewable energy technologies, civil works on the construction of three mini-grids at Azizkpe, Aflive and Alorkpem Islands in the Ada East District of the Greater Accra Region have been completed.

twi: Ho Atɔeɛ ne Tongu Atifi mansini no ho dwuma ma ɛkɔduruu ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduɔkron enum.
english: Ho West and North Tongu Districts is 95 percent complete.

twi: Yei enti sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Aban bɛtu atiridii yadeɛ ase no, ɔde afidie bi a wɔfrɛ no “LSM Implement app” a ɛtumi kyerɛ baabi a ntontom dɔre ma wɔhye wɔn ase wɔ Mansini ahodoɔ mu aba.
english: Thus, as part of Government’s efforts to eliminate malaria, an application (LSM Implement app) for mapping and treatment of mosquito breeding sites in the districts has been rolled out.

twi: Yei enti, Aban bɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ nam so ne nnwuma ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada ne deɛ afei na wɔrebɛfiri aseɛ aka wɔn ho abom nam so atrɛ nnwuma no mu, ɔbɛsiesie, asane de mfidie a ɛbɛyɛ adwadeɛ pɔtee a yɛde ani asi so no adi dwuma.
english: Consequently, the banks have committed a total of GH¢1.169 billion, which represents 30% of the funding portfolio, for the programme.

twi: Aban bɛkɔ so de ahohiahia ho ɔhwɛ a ɛfata ama wɔn a wɔbɛnya wɔn tiri adidi mu wɔ Nnipatɔn mu no, na wayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ako atia nnipatɔn, mpɔtam nsawɔsodie na wasane ahyehyɛ dwumadie a wɔnam so bɛtwe nnwumakuo a wɔko tia nnipatɔn no adwene asi nnipatɔn ho ɔhaw so.
english: Budget: A budget is a plan that outlines where to get money from and what to spend it on.

twi: Abibirem Aman mu Edwadie A Akwansideɛ Nni ho (African Continental Free Trade Area – AfCFTA): Yei yɛ edwa kɛseɛ a wɔahyehyɛ ama Abibirem Adwdeɛyɛ Nnwumakuo a ɛbɛboa ama wɔde wɔn adwadeɛ akɔ Abibirem aman so akɔtɔn a wɔrentua edwadie mu ɛtoɔ ahodoɔ biara na wɔanya edwa kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Abibirem ha no ho mfasoɔ.
english: African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA): A market created to eliminate tariffs on intra-Africa trade, making it easier for African businesses to trade within the continent and benefit from the growing African market.

twi: Sika Mu Nkyekyɛmu (Allocation): Yei yɛ ɛkwan a wɔfa so kyekyɛ ɔman sika mu ma Aban asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ no ne nnwumakuo ahodoɔ no ma wɔde di dwuma ma ɔmanfoɔ.
english: Allocation: The process of sharing or distributing resources amoung government agencies and departments.

twi: Afadeɛ (Apparel): Afadeɛ anaa atadeɛ pɔtee bi a wɔtɔn wɔ sotɔɔ mu.
Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ (Budget): Sikasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ gyina hɔ ma nhyehyɛeɛ a Aban ayɛ afa ɛkwan a ɔbɛfa so anya sika ne deɛ ɔde saa sika no bɛyɛ ho.
english: EXIM (Export-Import) Bank: Ghana Export-Import Bank (GEXIM) was established by the Ghana Export-Import Bank Act 2016 (Act 911) to support the government of Ghana’s quest for a feasible and sustainable export led economy.

twi: Nsiho-tua (Interest payments): Yei yɛ bosea anaa agyapadeɛ bi ho nsiho a ɔkafoɔ anaa deɛ wafiri agyapadeɛ no tua.
Mmɔborɔwafoɔ Aduonu (V20 - Vulnerable Twenty): Yeinom yɛ aman bi a wɔsusu sɛ ewiem nsakraeɛ ho nsuansuansoɔ a ano yɛ den no ka wɔn pa ara.
english: V20 (Vulnerable Twenty): They are detailed massive economic damage wrought by climate change on the economies representing countries considered the most vulnerable to climate change.
